title: NoLeaks
description: Client-side privacy mod that hides coordinates, chunk/block data and other meta information
body:
## NoLeaks is a mod to protect you from leak any information about your location 

It is made to reduce accidental location leaks in screenshots, videos, and streams. The mod can hide coordinates, chunk/block position, facing, biome, seed/worldgen data, scoreboard, chat, TAB list, bossbar, actionbar, subtitles, sky elements, weather/biome particles, projectiles, item drops, XP orbs, and portal effects.

It also adds a transparent settings screen that can be opened in-game or from the main menu before joining a world/server.

## Features:

Hide risky F3/debug lines

![Full F3 manage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2a63aa4252c263f821ccff234c57dfe0b43fbda.gif)

Hide coordinates, chunk/block position, facing, biome, and seed/worldgen metadata

**Meta-block rotation applies when NoLeaks and “Rotate meta-blocks” are enabled and the client rebuilds chunks; it rotates only the top texture of grass blocks and only the top/bottom faces of end stone and bedrock.**
![Meta-blocks rotations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cc16449dcc4bc570e15be790eff25e116945742.png)

Hide chat, scoreboard, TAB list, bossbar, actionbar, subtitles, and selected HUD elements

Normalize grass, foliage, water, Nether fog, and End fog colors

![Normalize biome blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89f4f89d59b736c28d2728d270d1cd0081ce3f57.png)

Hide clouds, stars, sun, moon, weather particles, and biome particles

Hide projectiles, ender pearls, item drops, XP orbs, and portal effects

Optional warnings/blocking for pearls and projectiles

![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3873777bf78bc6a2afa26af08e14795f5fb6c04.gif)

**Mod port on another versions will be later**
